description: Draft a governance-compliant GitHub issue for HUMAN review — never submitted (pdfnative-mcp v1.4 AI-governance / Human-In-The-Loop). draft_governance_issue assembles a local Markdown draft plus a structured compliance report and validates it against the zero-dependency + reproduction policy. The server makes NO outbound network call and has NO GitHub write path: present the returned draft and compliance report to the user, then STOP — they review and submit it manually under their own GitHub identity. Fully self-contained (no PDF needed).

arguments.title: add_table clips descenders on wrapped cells at default padding
arguments.summary: When a table cell wraps onto multiple lines, the descenders of g/j/p/q/y in the last line are clipped at the default cellPadding. Increasing cellPadding works around it but should not be required.

reproduction.command: add_table with headers ['Note'] and a wrapped cell containing 'paragraphy typography'
reproduction.result: The descenders of g/p/y in the wrapped line are visibly clipped in the rendered PDF.

arguments.expectedBehavior: Descenders render fully within the cell at the default padding.
arguments.actualBehavior: The bottom ~1pt of g/j/p/q/y is clipped on wrapped lines.
